transkript.t: You can now get Claude to run your entire Instagram page for you
and it's completely free to start.
It's called the Instagram agent skill
and it's not just one tool, it actually gives you 13 of them
and each one handles a different part of your page.
IG plan maps out your entire content for the week.
IG profile looks at your bio and your grid
and gives you a score out of 100
so you know exactly what to fix first.
IG Real writes all of your scripts
using 26 proven hook formulas that have already been tested
and IG Human goes back through everything
to remove any signs that it was written by AI.
But what is even more useful is IG Viral.
It studies all of the top creators in your niche
and then ranks which of their reels beats their usual views.
Then it pulls out the exact hooks
that did better than all of the other ones.
So you don't have to guess what to post next.
To set it up just paste the link straight into Claude
and if you comment real I'll send you the link
to get it set up for yourself.
